properties.explanation: No reachable state is a global deadlock.
There exists a reachable state where (function 'main::transfer_ab' has completed and function 'main::transfer_ba' has completed).
In every reachable state, no thread in 'main::transfer_ab' simultaneously holds all of [main::account_a_mutex, main::account_b_mutex].
In every reachable state, no thread in 'main::transfer_ba' simultaneously holds all of [main::account_a_mutex, main::account_b_mutex].

preserved.explanation: Behavior 'transfer_ab completes' must remain reachable (function 'main::transfer_ab' has completed).
Behavior 'transfer_ba completes' must remain reachable (function 'main::transfer_ba' has completed).

preserved.description: completed_transfers counter is incremented at least once
preserved.explanation: Behavior 'completed_transfers counter is incremented at least once' must remain reachable (main::completed_transfers >= 1).
